name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
label: Quest
description: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Then it is done? You have retrieved the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet and finally put to rest the spirit of my old companion, Mor Grayhoof?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done a great thing, friend. One spirit rests in peace, but there is still much work to be done before we can put all of this behind us.

Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
